method: Unmodified reviewed scripts in restricted Node vm; actual form/click/download handlers plus actual launch builder import; synthetic inputs; minimal DOM/storage stubs; no network, browser or live systems.
limits: Not browser persistence or IndexedDB durability
Launch import is logic only, not browser upload or a shared project store
No release approval or live contractor package

summary.overall: FAIL — complete integrated workflow not ready

results.detail: Actual submit handler creates a separate synthetic project with empty selections.
Kitchen design area exists; metadata is project-scoped.
Discussed selections do not feed budget output.
Selected items wait for a demo approval before output.
Demo approval feeds 2 × 100 = 200 into a budget draft; all amounts are fictional test input.
A synthetic drawing plus complete selection clears the prototype metadata blocker list.
Actual download handler produces a Draft contractor task with no invented owner/deadline.
Daily Workspace must show the project-linked action and return to the same project/budget step; passing is prototype logic only, not hosted/live Dashboard integration.
Draft contractor tasks require explicit predecessor/release references; no work is released.
Editing an approved item creates R2, retains R1 history and removes the changed item from approved outputs pending reapproval.
Prior approved history must preserve the actual former unit cost and cost code.
Budget export must carry project ID, selection ID and approved revision.
Existing logical task identity must survive inserting another approved item; no particular key format is assumed.
Formula-leading text must be neutralized in spreadsheet-facing CSV. No formula is executed.
Missing cost remains unknown/blank, not zero.
Draft export does not invent assignments or dates.
The prototype escapes text containing HTML.
Single-home dependency IDs must resolve to real checklist/package tasks and remain unreleased.
Actual form-created selections produce unique stable global task and selection IDs.
Dangerous text markers are quoted as text; typed numeric values remain numbers. Consumer/resave behavior is not tested.
Import the actual reusable launch builder output: preserve subdivision Project ID, all 29 task IDs and dependencies. This is logic, not a browser upload or shared store.
Repeated launch import must not create a duplicate Project ID.
Quick-created renovation must contain its referenced contract/release gate tasks; dangling predecessors are a setup defect, not satisfied gates.
Missing contract authority T17 must block actual export, not silently remove the approval gate from dependencies.
An unapproved predecessor must not create a dangling contractor task reference; block export or require the predecessor approval.
